lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Walking through the shadows of the night
Chasing every spark of fading light
Heavy drums are beating in my chest
Finding where the weary spirits rest
[Pre-Chorus]
The ground begins to shake and sway
The colors wash the clouds away
[Chorus]
Rise above the thunder and the rain
Break the silence, break the heavy chain
Higher than the mountains touch the sky
Where the golden eagles fly so high
[Verse]
Iron hearts are beating steady ground
Lost within the echoes of the sound
Every step is heavy, every breath is deep
Promises the waking world will keep
[Pre-Chorus]
The ground begins to shake and sway
The colors wash the cloud away
[Chorus]
Rise above the thunder and the rain
Break the silence, break the heavy chain
Higher than the mountains touch the sky
Where the golden eagles fly so high
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
In the quiet of the hollow space
I find the peace of a hidden place
[Chorus]
Rise above the thunder and the rain
Break the silence, break the heavy chain
Higher than the mountains touch the sky
Where the golden eagles fly so high
[Outro]
